newsitem.title: USA: Quaker State said completes Medo purchase.
newsitem.headline: Quaker State said completes Medo purchase.

text.p: Quaker State Corp said on Thursday it completed the previously announced acquisition of air freshener manufacturer Medo Companies for $160 million, including the payment of Medo's debt.
Quaker said in a statement former Medo stockholders have agreed to buy about 250,000 shares of Quaker stock on the open market over the next six months for investment purposes, as part of the deal.

New York-based Medo designs, manufactures and markets air freshener products for automobiles. It had sales of about $60 million in 1995. Quaker said Medo's sales have grown about 25 percent a year since 1992.
